name: Disodium coco-sulfosuccinate
description: Disodium coco-sulfosuccinate (CAS 90268-37-4 ) is a mild, coconut-derived anionic surfactant used across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. Derived from fatty alcohols of coconut oil and sulfosuccinic acid, it delivers effective cleansing. It provides excellent foam generation while remaining gentle on skin and compatible with sensitive formulation systems. In personal care, it functions as a primary or co-surfactant in shampoos, body washes, and baby care products. Home care formulators incorporate it into liquid dish soaps and hard surface cleaners where it boosts grease removal. It is particularly valued for maintaining skin tolerance during repeated contact in manual cleaning tasks. Textile and leather processors use it as a wetting and scouring agent to improve substrate penetration during pre-treatment. It is also utilized in dyeing operations to ensure uniform application across various fiber types. In paper manufacturing, it supports pulp dispersion and surface sizing processes where consistent foam behavior is critical. Its compatibility with process water makes it a reliable choice for large-scale industrial paper production. Disodium coco-sulfosuccinate is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with active matter content commonly in the range of 30–40%. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades for diverse industrial needs. Cosmetic-grade material meets purity requirements for personal care applications and high-end formulations.
